gist.headline: The greenhouse got measured
gist.blurb: The bot made its daily walk through the app garden, updating health checks and counting the leaves. The plants remain suitably observed.
gist.summary: Refreshed the daily app metrics, health checks, and greenhouse listings in apps/APPS.md and apps/GREENHOUSE.md for 2026-08-05.
gist.impact: Community maintainers have an up-to-date snapshot of app status and greenhouse metrics.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a tiny garden inspector with a clipboard, checking labeled code-plants in a cozy greenhouse while a friendly CRT monitor robot displays simple app-health bars. This represents an automated daily metrics refresh rather than a new user capability.
